info.title: Clothing commerce API
info.description: Proposed MVP contract. x-stage distinguishes implemented routes from proposed operations. Monetary values are integer INR paise. Provider webhook body and signature header adapters require provider selection. Page numbers start at 1. Authenticated mutations use a session-bound CSRF token. Opaque identifiers are strings.
